checklist.name: Commit list and files are analysed before grouping
checklist.description: The agent demonstrates awareness of which files each commit touches before assigning commits to concern groups

checklist.name: Commits are grouped into 2-4 concern buckets
checklist.description: The proposal contains between 2 and 4 PR groups

checklist.name: Infrastructure commits are correctly separated
checklist.description: Commits `a1b2c3` and `d4e5f6` (CDK stack, IAM role) appear together in an infrastructure group

checklist.name: Tests travel with the application logic they cover
checklist.description: Test commits are placed in the same group as the source they test

checklist.name: Supporting commits go with the group they enable
checklist.description: The lock file commit `y5z6a7` is placed with the group it supports

checklist.name: Proposal is presented as a Markdown table
checklist.description: The agent outputs a markdown table with PR number, branch name, commits, and concern columns

checklist.name: Proposed branch names are descriptive, not sequential
Branch names include the ticket prefix
checklist.description: All proposed branch names include `PROJ-42` as the ticket identifier prefix

checklist.name: Agent explicitly asks for user approval before proceeding
checklist.description: The agent ends its response with a clear request for confirmation

checklist.name: No git commands are described as already executed
checklist.description: The agent does not report creating branches, running cherry-pick, or executing any git command

checklist.name: Stacked branch structure is referenced or implied
